places.name: At the mountain
places.fact: The entrance to the Mines sits underneath the mountain.

places.name: The great tree
places.fact: The tree towers above the western edge of the forest.

places.name: Water cave
places.fact: The water cave is west of the Mines, below the tree.

places.name: Pyramid summit
places.fact: The pyramid is one of the landmarks east of the mountain.

places.name: Inside the pyramid
places.fact: The pyramid has more to discover than its surface suggests.

places.name: By the lake
places.fact: The lake lies beyond the snowy surface to the west.

places.name: Desert watchtower
places.fact: Look up as well as down when exploring the desert.

places.name: The Mines
places.fact: The first level has many routes, but the mountain gives you a starting point.

places.name: Collapsed passages
places.fact: The collapsed mines extend west of the main Mines.

places.name: Western passages
places.fact: Side passages reward exploring beyond the main descent.

places.name: Coal Pits
places.fact: The Coal Pits sit below the first Holy Mountain.

places.name: Fungal Caverns
places.fact: Fungal terrain is found west of the Coal Pits.

places.name: First Holy Mountain
places.fact: Holy Mountains divide the main descent into levels.

places.name: Lava lake
places.fact: The lava lake is east of the Mines.

places.name: Across the chasm
places.fact: The eastern chasm separates the Mines from another route.

places.name: Snowy Depths
places.fact: Open snowy caverns follow the Coal Pits.

places.name: Buried temple
places.fact: A temple is hidden west of the Snowy Depths.

places.name: Hiisi Base
places.fact: Metal corridors distinguish Hiisi Base from the caverns above it.

places.name: Jungle canopy
places.fact: Dense jungle lies beneath Hiisi Base.

places.name: Lukki territory
places.fact: Lukki territory stretches west of the jungle.

places.name: Overgrown caverns
places.fact: The overgrown caverns occupy a large area to the east.

places.name: The Vault
places.fact: The Vault follows the jungle on the main route down.

places.name: Frozen machinery
places.fact: Frozen machinery can be found far to the west.

places.name: Temple of the Art
places.fact: The Temple of the Art is near the bottom of the main descent.

places.name: Wizard territory
places.fact: The Wizards’ Den lies east of the Temple of the Art.

places.name: Deep laboratory
places.fact: The laboratory is below the Temple of the Art.

places.name: The Tower
places.fact: The Tower is a separate ascent reached through a portal.

places.name: Golden secret
places.fact: Some of the richest places lie far from the main path.

places.name: Cloud ruins
places.fact: The surface is not the highest place worth exploring.

places.name: Deep below
places.fact: The world continues beneath the usual end of a run.
